name: Sibling Love
overview: Scripture reveals that sibling love is characterized by unity, kindness, and steadfast support, especially in times of adversity. The psalmist celebrates the goodness and pleasantness of brethren dwelling together in unity, while Proverbs highlights that a brother is born to provide help during difficult times. Christ warns against harboring anger or contempt toward a brother, emphasizing the seriousness of such offenses. Believers are called to show brotherly affection, honoring one another and maintaining patience and prayerfulness amid trials, trusting that the Lord fights on their behalf.
